title: Supply switch, frequency, valve and circulation pump have no restore owner on off, unload or remove
claim: Four written entities -- the heat-pump power switch (left off after an idle step), the compressor frequency number (45 against 70), the mixing-valve target (18 against 22) and the hot-water circulation pump (left off) -- stay at the optimizer's last value after Off, after unload and after the entry is removed, because none of their writers registers with off_restore.
mechanism: off_restore restores only consumers registered at import (heat_curve, heat_curve_mqtt, pump_arbiter_space). pump_arbiter.switch_supply, coordinator._command_frequency, coordinator._command_valve_target and coordinator._async_set_pump only stop writing in MODE_OFF ('off writes nothing') and on unload; nothing writes their baseline back. After async_remove_entry no later setup can either, so a pump switched off on an idle step stays off.

evidence.machine: box B11 (shared, up to three compute seats)
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats may share B11; the number is a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D16/s3/m6_restore.py --perturb consumers: register off_restore consumers for the supply switch (neutral on), the frequency and the valve (pre-write reading) and the circulation pump (neutral on), armed before each write

metric_definition: Per trigger: count of written entities outside the arbiter's slots whose final state differs from the pre-write state; key = state the delivered service calls left.
phenomenon_property: Every entity any write site of enumerate.py d16-writes commands is returned to its baseline once on Off, unload and remove; a writer outside off_restore's consumers is the defect.
seam_rule: python3 tools/audit/enumerate.py d16-writes | grep '^write' (each site whose entity no off_restore.register_consumer covers)

null_control.note: commands equal to each baseline: nothing to restore, nothing counted

reproduction_steps: run the command; read RESULT unrestored_<trigger>_unregistered and the per-entity lines for switch.hp, number.freq, number.valve, switch.vvc
re-run with --perturb consumers: the unregistered counts read 0
proposed_fix_scope: Register the power switch, the frequency number, the valve write entity and the circulation pumps with off_restore (arm before each write), or give each writer an equivalent restore on Off, unload and remove.
